page.overview:
Who is Berisha Terakuni?

Berisha Terakuni was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She had hard eyes and a narrow face. She was lean and the same height as Egwene al'Vere. She spoke with a strong Arafellin accent.

We have no precise description of Berisha's strength in the One Power from the Companion, although her ability to open a gateway large enough for a cart with passenger to pass through indicates she is at least a strength of . She also seems to offer resistance to Katerine Alruddin, which she would not be able to do if she were much weaker. Since Katerine has a strength of , Berisha can be guessed to have a level between and , making her considerably above average among Aes Sedai.

She was from Arafel. She stood high in the Aes Sedai hierarchy.
